source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of creating a business plan (PDF 209).

blocks.text: Business plan karobar shuru karne aur chalane ka naqsha hai: yeh mansooba banata hai ke aap kya karna chahte hain, kaise karenge aur kaise kamyab honge.

blocks.prompt: Business plan ko naqshe se tashbeeh kyun dein?
blocks.explanation: Naqshe ki tarah yeh dikhata hai ke kahan jana hai aur kaunsa raasta hai, to raste mein bhatakne ka imkan kam hota hai.

items: Business plan: kya, kaise aur kamyabi ka naqsha.
